nodes.text: @P_McCulloughMD @McCulloughFund I question if the human metapneumovirus has been a gain of function man- made pathogen after I have seen clinically how  it progresses from ST/ nasal congestion into 2ndary bacterial pneumonia. IV Rocephin/oral Azithromycin works well when started early on.
